versions.title: Version 1 · before five-project QA
versions.purpose: Review the original construction workbench before validation, interaction, programme-label and IFC QA improvements.
versions.status: Frozen historical model and calculations; shared navigation and responsive presentation. Use v5 for the current proposed basis, or v4 for its preserved audited baseline.

versions.title: Version 2 · five-project QA improvements
versions.purpose: Use the maintained linked 2D, 3D, quantity and Gantt workbench, with stronger validation, inspection controls and exchange checks.
versions.status: Preserved v2 workbench baseline; the existing root address and v2 still derive from one source.

versions.title: Version 3 · detailed drawings and quantities
versions.purpose: Inspect excavation cut-edge clearances, named members, source-linked reinforcement and individual bars, configurable annotation layers and concrete material scenarios.
versions.status: Preserved detailed-drawing baseline. V4 corrects the documented mathematics and adds conditional codal checks.

versions.title: Version 4 · checked detailing and BBS study
versions.purpose: Use audited source dimensions, coherent stair steel, union concrete quantities, conditional Nepal-code spacing checks, explicit trial layouts and a readable mobile BBS study.
versions.source: Build-time derivation from v3 plus v4 checked-model / drawing / interface modules
versions.status: Preserved v4 audited baseline. V5 adds proposed shaped pieces and separately labelled design assumptions.

versions.title: Version 5 · proposed fabrication and 3D checks
versions.purpose: Review explicit material/cover decisions, rounded bar shapes, exact proposed cuts, confinement-area and lap-fit checks, stock estimates and actual-browser rendering diagnostics.
versions.source: Build-time v4 derivation plus v5 proposed-model / shape / viewer modules
versions.status: Preserved v5 proposed basis; its nominal column closures remain unresolved. V6 adds two-piece beam closures, rejected reference-coupler fit checks and default vector3D.

versions.title: Version6 · beam closures and column connections
versions.purpose: Inspect dimensioned two-piece beam links, separate U/cap quantities, staggered column splice levels, actual sleeve/hoop clash checks and a reliable vector3D default.
versions.source: Build-time v5 derivation plus v6 connection geometry, view and decision modules; canonical source unchanged
versions.status: Current dimensioned coordination workspace. Reference TT product rejected for seismic supply and cage clashes. Column closures remain held; no structural/fabrication release.

policy: V1 is a checksum-verified frozen model/calculation snapshot with a shared navigation and mobile reading shell. V2 and the existing URL are generated from the same maintained workbench source. The hub and change report derive from this version record and shared comparison text. Historical snapshots are not duplicate editable masters. V3 derives from the same base model and v2 work calculators with a separate, source-linked review patch record; v2 geometry and quantities are preserved. V4 derives its page/controller at build time from v3 and shares the canonical model; corrections and code scenarios live only in v4 modules. V1-v3 remain available. V5 derives from v4 without another editable building model; proposed choices are separate from source facts and earlier versions. V6 reuses v5/v4 and the canonical building source; new connection geometry and decisions have one versioned owner. V1-v5 are preserved.
